Two other 'failures' were false positives from the test script (CSS uppercase transform on badge; boolean cells rendered as icons rather than text) and the underlying functionality is correct. All copy, plan IDs, prices, notes, feature bullets, signup CTAs, comparison table rows + values, shared services + links, header nav (incl. position between Specials and How), mobile drawer and footer regression all pass.

ui_bugs.issue: Featured 'Free + Feeder' card is missing the orange border. Tailwind utility `border-[#F25C05]` is being overridden by the global `.card-soft` rule in index.css which uses the CSS shorthand `border: 1px solid var(--sp-border-subtle);`. Shorthand resets border-color so the orange utility never wins. Computed border-color resolves to rgba(10, 77, 140, 0.1) instead of #F25C05. Visual impact: the featured card looks identical to the other two cards (only the 'MOST POPULAR' badge and slight translate distinguish it).

action_items: Fix the featured card orange border. Two clean options: (a) In /app/frontend/src/index.css change `.card-soft` from the `border:` shorthand to longhand (`border-width: 1px; border-style: solid; border-color: var(--sp-border-subtle);`) so that Tailwind's `border-[#F25C05]` utility can override only `border-color`. (b) In PlansPage.jsx replace `border-2 border-[#F25C05]` with an inline style `style={{ borderColor: '#F25C05', borderWidth: '2px' }}` or add a small CSS rule with higher specificity for `.card-soft.is-featured`. Option (a) is the most reusable fix.
critical_code_review_comments: CSS specificity trap in /app/frontend/src/index.css: `.card-soft { border: 1px solid var(--sp-border-subtle); }` silently overrides any Tailwind `border-[...]` color utility applied alongside it. This will keep biting any component that tries to recolor a card-soft border. Recommend switching to longhand border-color in the base class.

PlansPage.jsx 283 lines — within healthy limits but starts to accumulate constant data + JSX. If more plan tiers or rows are added consider extracting PLANS / FEATURE_ROWS / SHARED_SERVICES into /lib/plansData.js.
Comparison `<Cell value={true/false}>` is purely icon-based with no accessible label. Adding `aria-label='Included' / 'Not included'` on the icon span would help screen readers for the row values.

rca of the issue: Root cause of the missing orange border on the featured plan card: in /app/frontend/src/index.css line 137-142, `.card-soft` declares the border using the `border:` shorthand. The shorthand expands to border-width + border-style + border-color, so the explicit border-color reset always lands at the same specificity as the Tailwind utility `border-[#F25C05]`. Because index.css component layer is emitted after @tailwind utilities in the compiled stylesheet (or at equal specificity with later source order), the shorthand wins and the orange color never applies. Reproduction: open /plans at 1920x1080, inspect the middle card → computed border-color = rgba(10,77,140,0.1). Mitigation: change `.card-soft` to use border longhand (border-width / border-style / border-color) so Tailwind's `border-[#F25C05]` only competes on border-color and wins.
